title: System Diagnostic Doctor
description: The Doctor checks your computer to ensure everything that ERREETOOL needs is installed properly. It verifies your internet connection, your admin permissions, and checks for external helper tools.
tips: If any checks fail, follow the warnings to fix the missing dependencies.
Some commands like ARP scanning specifically require 'Admin Privileges' to work.
Make sure Python packages ('requirements.txt') are newly installed if there's a library warning.
